case_title.quote: KILAKKATHA PARAMBATH SASI & ORS. v. STATE OF KERALA

number_of_accused.quote: reversed the acquittal of four accused (the appellants)
number_of_accused.reason: Four appellants' liability is decided by the Court.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment does not expressly state the accused's gender.

accused_religion.quote: the accused persons belonged to the Bhartiya Janta Party
accused_religion.reason: Only political affiliation is given, not religion.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community is stated.

victim_gender.quote: his brother also traveling by the same bus
victim_gender.reason: The deceased, Sathyan, is a male brother of PW-1.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the deceased and PW-1 were workers of the Congress Party
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Political rivalry is the described connection.

offence_category.quote: convicted under Section 302 r/w Section 34 IPC

statutory_provisions.reason: Charged sections and the final s.302/34 conviction are accurate.

weapon.reason: Matches; the crow bar and sticks are mentioned as prosecution suggestions.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, FIR and trip-sheet evidence are all discussed.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: 58 injuries thereon, most of them incised and cutting wounds

trial_court_outcome.quote: The Trial Court acquitted all the seven accused.

high_court_outcome.quote: reversed the acquittal of four accused... life imprisonment, whereas the acquittal of other three accused was maintained

offence_finally_established.quote: convicted under Section 302 r/w Section 34 IPC

imprisonment_years.reason: Not a fixed term, so null is right.

neutral_facts.reason: Accurate to the prosecution case, anonymized, and does not reveal outcome.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: his brother died at the hospital

physical_harm.quote: three incised wounds were found on him as well

number_of_offences.reason: Five sections charged; one conviction stands.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not decided by the Supreme Court; prosecution alleged accused waited at Babu's shop for the victims. The 'deliberation' remark was a false-implication argument.
premeditation_planning.quote: the accused had been involved after deliberation
premeditation_planning.reason: Defence 'deliberation' point concerned false implication, not planning of the attack; the prosecution's waiting allegation is missing.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Injured PW-1's testimony, prompt FIR, and PWs 2, 3 and 4; the trip-sheet was not relied on as proof.
key_evidence_accepted.quote: The prosecution story is also fully supported by the evidence of PWs 2,3 and 4.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Trip-sheet and medical evidence were not relied on as accepted evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: There is absolutely no reason as to why his statement should be discarded.

trial_duration.reason: Offence, High Court and Supreme Court dates are right; trial date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: U.R. Lalit, E.M.S. Anam, Fazlin Anam for the Appellants

investigation_status.quote: On the completion of the investigation, the accused were charged

procedural_irregularity.quote: their non-examination case would not mean that the entire prosecution story would fall through

prosecution_argument.quote: merely because PW-1 did not name all the seven accused at the first instance, was of no consequence

defence_argument.quote: the facts did not justify interference in an appeal against acquittal

legal_principle_applied.quote: the High Court can re-appraise the evidence

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Arulvelu and Anr. Vs. State represented by the Public Prosecutor and Anr. [2009 (10) SCC 206]
